questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Jupiter is the ______ planet in our solar system.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **biggest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• If one thing is chosen out of 'more than two' or 'all', a superlative degree is preceded by the article 'the'.
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Jack is one of the best of all players in our school.*
 
 
 
• Since the definite article 'the' precedes the given blank, the adjective 'biggest' will be the correct choice here.

 

Correct sentence__- *Jupiter is the **biggest **planet in our solar system.*

* *​​​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• If one thing is chosen out of the two, a comparative degree is preceded by 'the' and followed by 'of'.
 
• Example:
 
 
• Arko is the best of the two musicians. (incorrect)
 
• Arko is the better of the two musicians. (correct)

questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

The policeman said, “We are stopping the defaulters of the lockdown.”

options.text: The policeman says that they are stopping the defaulters of the lockdown.
The policeman said that they were stopping the defaulters of the lockdown.
The policeman told that he was stopping the defaulters of the lockdown.
The policeman said that we are stopping the defaulters of the lockdown.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **The policeman said that they were stopping the defaulters of the lockdown.​ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the steps to change the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• When the direct speech is in an assertive form, we follow the steps given below:
 
 
• Convert the sentence in the direct speech into assertive.
 
• The tense of reported speech is changed only when the reporting verb is in the past tense. 
 
• The reporting verb said will remain the same.
 
• The pronoun 'We' is replaced by 'they' accordingly. 
 
• The present continuous tense i.e. are stopping will be changed to the past continuous tense i.e. were stopping.
 
 
 
• ​​At last line up the remaining part.

 

Following these steps, we finally get- *The policeman said that they were stopping the defaulters of the lockdown.*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The bus ______ before I reached the bus stand.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is had left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• If two actions take place in the past in succession, the structure is given below:

 
 
• ​1st action- Past perfect tense i.e. Sub + had + V3 + Obj.
 
• 2nd action- Simple past tense i.e. Sub+ V2 + Obj.
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *The patient had passed away before the surgeon arrived.*
 
 
 
• Thus in the blank part of the given question, 'had left' will be used as it is the 1st action in the given sentence.

 

Correct Sentence__: *The bus **had left **before I reached the bus stand.*

* *​​​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• The past perfect is a verb tense used to talk about actions that were completed before some point in the past.
 
• The formula for the past perfect tense is had + [past participle].

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

She did not accept the job of a clerk.

options.text: The job of a clerk is not accepted by her.
The job of a clerk did not accept her.
The job of a clerk has not accepted her.
The job of a clerk was not accepted by her.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The job of a clerk was not accepted by her.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in an active voice form, hence we need to convert it into a passive voice form.
 
• Find the subject (She) and object (The job of a clerk) of the sentence and exchange their places. 
 
• The given sentence is in the simple past tense. The passive verb form for simple past is: 
 
 
• was/were + past participle form of the verb.
 
• So, 'did not accept' changes to 'was not accepted'.
 
 
 
• At last line up the remaining part.

 ​

Following these steps, we get - *The job of a clerk was not accepted by her.*
